title: A token's speed halves inside difficult terrain
description: Three rect zones on one board. The swamp (tag difficult) is 6x4 at [10, 10]: x 7..13, y 8..12. The rubble (tag difficult) is 4x2 at [13, 9]: x 11..15, y 8..10, overlapping the swamp's east edge. The road (tag road) is 4x4 at [0, 10]: x -2..2, y 8..12. Aldric's token (base_speed 30) walks from open ground through the road, into the swamp, into the swamp/rubble overlap, and out. The road and the overlap are variants chosen by this transcription to show that the tag, not zone-ness, slows the token, and that overlapping difficult zones halve once.

expect.note: "speed = base_speed / if(len(zones_containing(this).where(tag has "difficult")) > 0, 2, 1)": FORMULAS §6: `zones_containing(obj)` is "Zones on the object's board whose region contains its anchor." [0, 0] is in no zone, so 30 / 1.
"speed = base_speed / if(len(zones_containing(this).where(tag has "difficult")) > 0, 2, 1)": the road contains him but fails .where(tag has "difficult"), so 30 / 1.
"`move` the token into the zone (`speed` 15)" (FIXTURES §9): [10, 10] is in the swamp, 30 / 2.

steps.note: Aldric reaches the part of the swamp covered by rubble.

expect.note: "speed = base_speed / if(len(zones_containing(this).where(tag has "difficult")) > 0, 2, 1)": two difficult zones contain [12, 9], but the divisor is 2 whenever the count is > 0, so 15, not 7.5.

steps.note: Aldric climbs out north of the swamp.

expect.note: "and out (30)" (FIXTURES §9): y 14 is outside every zone.
FIXTURES §6: `move` "Drag an object to a destination"; FIXTURES §7: `placement` holds when "The object is on that board at that anchor".
